category_title: Verbal students with ASD who meet their own needs and show resistance to adult direction
scenario_title: Play-based interaction session with blocks and balls
minimal_context: The student is participating in a one-on-one play session using blocks and balls.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our play session. Let's build a tall tower with these blocks. Put this red block on top.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns her body away from the tutor, ignoring the instruction, and pulls all the blocks towards herself to meet her own needs)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to do this together. Please hand me a block so we can build it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want the balls. (Quickly grabs the balls to play with them by herself)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to listen to my instructions first. Put the balls down and stack the blocks like I asked.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! My way! (Protests loudly and pushes the blocks off the table, determined to have her own way)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our play session. Let's build a tall tower with these blocks. Put this red block on top.

STUDENT: (Turns her body away from the tutor, ignoring the instruction, and pulls all the blocks towards herself to meet her own needs)

TUTOR: We need to do this together. Please hand me a block so we can build it.

STUDENT: I want the balls. (Quickly grabs the balls to play with them by herself)

TUTOR: You need to listen to my instructions first. Put the balls down and stack the blocks like I asked.

STUDENT: No! My way! (Protests loudly and pushes the blocks off the table, determined to have her own way)
